query: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?

nodes.label: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
nodes.description: Identify the most effective dietary approach for reducing premenstrual syndrome (PMS) symptoms.

nodes.label: Which nutrients are most effective in reducing PMS symptoms?
nodes.description: Determine the key nutrients that help alleviate PMS symptoms like mood swings, bloating, and cramps.

nodes.label: What dietary patterns are recommended for PMS symptom relief?
nodes.description: Identify specific dietary patterns or regimens that are known to reduce PMS symptoms.

nodes.label: What lifestyle or dietary factors should be avoided to reduce PMS symptoms?
nodes.description: Determine which foods or habits exacerbate PMS symptoms and should be minimized or eliminated.

nodes.label: magnesium content
nodes.description: The presence of magnesium, which helps with muscle relaxation and mood regulation.

nodes.label: vitamin B levels
nodes.description: The availability of B vitamins, which help with energy and mood stabilization.

nodes.label: calcium intake
nodes.description: The amount of calcium, which supports bone health and may reduce cramps and mood swings.

nodes.label: fiber content
nodes.description: The presence of dietary fiber, which supports digestion and helps regulate blood sugar.

nodes.label: anti-inflammatory foods
nodes.description: The inclusion of foods that reduce inflammation, such as omega-3s and flaxseed.

nodes.label: sugar reduction
nodes.description: The minimization of sugar intake to prevent blood sugar spikes and mood instability.

nodes.label: caffeine reduction
nodes.description: The reduction of caffeine to avoid exacerbating anxiety and irritability.

nodes.label: omega-3 inclusion
nodes.description: The presence of omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and cramps.

nodes.label: hydration support
nodes.description: The inclusion of water-rich foods and fluids to reduce bloating and support overall health.

nodes.label: ease of adherence
nodes.description: The practicality and sustainability of the diet for long-term use.

nodes.label: Mediterranean-style diet
nodes.description: A diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, healthy fats, and lean proteins.

nodes.label: Dairy-free / Cycle Diet
nodes.description: A diet that avoids dairy and follows a structured nutritional plan aligned with hormonal cycles.

nodes.label: Anti-inflammatory elimination diet
nodes.description: A diet focused on reducing inflammation by eliminating processed foods and emphasizing whole, nutrient-dense foods.
